properties.displayName: Authentication ASIM parser for Salesforce Login History
properties.query:
let parser = (
    disabled: bool = false,
    pack: bool = false
) {
    SalesforceLoginHistory
    | where not(disabled)
    | extend EventTime = coalesce(LoginTime, TimeGenerated)
    | extend NormalizedSourceIp = iff(
        isnotnull(parse_ipv4(SourceIp)) or isnotempty(parse_ipv6(SourceIp)),
        SourceIp,
        "")
    | extend TargetUrl = iff(
        isempty(LoginUrl),
        "",
        iff(LoginUrl startswith "http://"
            or LoginUrl startswith "https://",
            LoginUrl,
            strcat("https://", LoginUrl)))
    | extend LoginUrlFQDN = tostring(parse_url(TargetUrl)["Host"])
    | extend TargetFQDN = case(
        isnotempty(SalesforceDomain), SalesforceDomain,
        isnotempty(LoginUrlFQDN), LoginUrlFQDN,
        LoginUrl)
    | invoke _ASIM_ResolveFQDN('TargetFQDN')
    | extend
        TargetAppName = iff(isnotempty(TargetFQDN), TargetFQDN, "Salesforce"),
        ActingAppName = iff(isnotempty(Application), Application, Browser),
        ActingAppType = case(
            isnotempty(Application), "SaaS application",
            isnotempty(Browser), "Browser",
            "Other"),
        EventResult = case(
            Status =~ "Success", "Success",
            isempty(Status), "NA",
            "Failure"),
        EventResultDetails = case(
            Status =~ "Success" or isempty(Status), "",
            Status =~ "Invalid Password", "Incorrect password",
            Status in~ ("Password Lockout", "User is Frozen"), "User locked",
            Status =~ "User is Inactive", "User disabled",
            Status in~ (
                "Lightning Login required",
                "Multi-factor required",
                "Passwordless Login via Passkeys required"
            ), "MFA not satisfied",
            Status in~ (
                "Failed: Not approved",
                "Failed: Not approved for access",
                "No community access",
                "Restricted IP",
                "Username-Password Flow Disabled"
            ), "Logon violates policy",
            "Other"),
        DvcAction = case(
            Status =~ "Success", "Allowed",
            isempty(Status), "",
            "Blocked")
    | extend
        LogonMethod = case(
            LoginSubType =~ "OAuth Client Credentials", "Service Principal",
            LoginSubType =~ "OAuth OTP Login"
                or Status in~ (
                    "Lightning Login required",
                    "Multi-factor required",
                    "Passwordless Login via Passkeys required"
                )
                or AuthMethodReference contains "multipleauthn",
                "Multi factor authentication",
            AuthMethodReference contains "x509"
                or AuthMethodReference contains "smartcard",
                "PKI",
            LoginType contains "Passwordless"
                or AuthMethodReference contains "fido",
                "Passwordless",
            LoginSubType in~ (
                "OAuth Username-Password",
                "UI Password Reset",
                "UI Username-Password"
            )
                or Status =~ "Invalid Password",
                "Username & Password",
            "Other"),
        LogonProtocol = case(
            LoginSubType contains "OAuth", "OAuth",
            LoginSubType contains "SOAP", "SOAP",
            LoginType contains "SAML", "SAML",
            LoginSubType startswith "UI", "Basic Auth",
            LoginSubType =~ "Internal Salesforce Authentication", "Salesforce",
            "Other"),
        EventSubType = case(
            LoginSubType contains "OAuth"
                or LoginSubType contains "SOAP"
                or LoginType in~ (
                    "Application",
                    "Other Apex API",
                    "Remote Access 2.0",
                    "Remote Access Client",
                    "Salesforce Outlook Integration"
                ),
                "Service",
            "Interactive"),
        SrcDeviceType = case(
            Platform startswith "Android"
                or Platform in~ ("iOS/Mac", "iPad", "iPhone"),
                "Mobile Device",
            Platform startswith "Windows"
                or Platform in~ ("Linux", "Mac OSX"),
                "Computer",
            isnotempty(Platform), "Other",
            "")
    | extend
        EventUid = hash_sha256(strcat(
            TenantId, "|",
            tostring(EventTime), "|",
            UserId, "|",
            SourceIp, "|",
            LoginType, "|",
            LoginSubType, "|",
            Application, "|",
            LoginUrl, "|",
            Status)),
        AdditionalFields = iff(
            pack,
            bag_pack(
                "ApiType", ApiType,
                "ApiVersion", ApiVersion,
                "AuthMethodReference", AuthMethodReference,
                "Browser", Browser,
                "CipherSuite", CipherSuite,
                "ClientVersion", ClientVersion,
                "ForwardedForIp", ForwardedForIp,
                "LoginGeoId", LoginGeoId,
                "OptionsIsGet", OptionsIsGet,
                "OptionsIsPost", OptionsIsPost,
                "SourceIp", SourceIp,
                "SourceSystem", SourceSystem,
                "LoginTime", LoginTime,
                "TenantId", TenantId,
                "TlsProtocol", TlsProtocol,
                "_BilledSize", _BilledSize,
                "_IsBillable", _IsBillable
            ),
            dynamic({}))
    | project-rename
        ActingAppId = AuthenticationServiceId,
        ActingOriginalAppType = ApiType,
        EventOriginalSubType = LoginSubType,
        EventOriginalType = LoginType,
        EventProductVersion = ApiVersion,
        HttpUserAgent = Browser,
        SrcDvcOs = Platform,
        SrcGeoCountry = CountryIso,
        TargetAppId = NetworkId
    | project
        TimeGenerated,
        Type = "SalesforceLoginHistory",
        EventCount = toint(1),
        EventEndTime = EventTime,
        EventMessage = Status,
        EventOriginalResultDetails = Status,
        EventOriginalSubType,
        EventOriginalType,
        EventProduct = "Salesforce Login History",
        EventProductVersion,
        EventResult,
        EventResultDetails,
        EventSchema = "Authentication",
        EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
        EventSeverity = "Informational",
        EventStartTime = EventTime,
        EventSubType,
        EventType = "Logon",
        EventUid,
        EventVendor = "Salesforce",
        ActingAppId,
        ActingAppName,
        ActingAppType,
        ActingOriginalAppType,
        ActingApplicationEntityKey = "",
        ActorUserAdditionalIds = dynamic([]),
        ActorUserEntityKey = "",
        AdditionalEntities = dynamic([]),
        AdditionalFields,
        Application = TargetAppName,
        Dst = coalesce(FQDN, tostring(ExtractedHostname)),
        Dvc = "Salesforce Login History",
        DvcAction,
        DvcDescription = "Salesforce authentication service",
        DvcDomain = "",
        DvcDomainType = "",
        DvcEntityKey = "",
        DvcFQDN = "",
        DvcHostname = "",
        HttpUserAgent,
        IpAddr = NormalizedSourceIp,
        LogonMethod,
        LogonProtocol,
        LogonTarget = coalesce(FQDN, tostring(ExtractedHostname)),
        Src = NormalizedSourceIp,
        SrcDeviceType,
        SrcDvcOs,
        SrcGeoCountry,
        SrcHostname = "",
        SrcIpAddr = NormalizedSourceIp,
        SrcSystemEntityKey = "",
        TargetAppId,
        TargetApplicationEntityKey = "",
        TargetAppName,
        TargetAppType = "SaaS application",
        TargetDomain = tostring(Domain),
        TargetDomainType = DomainType,
        TargetFQDN = FQDN,
        TargetHostname = tostring(ExtractedHostname),
        TargetSystemEntityKey = "",
        TargetUrl,
        TargetUserAdditionalIds = dynamic([]),
        TargetUserEntityKey = "",
        TargetUserId = UserId,
        TargetUserIdType = iff(isnotempty(UserId), "SalesforceId", ""),
        User = UserId
};
parser(disabled=disabled, pack=pack)
